blind.description: A rectangular, freestanding straight masonry wall section constructed from dark charcoal-brown rectangular stone ashlar blocks. A single horizontal row features a section of reddish-brown/terracotta accent bricks embedded into the masonry pattern. Surfaces are solid, flat, and continuous with clearly defined recessed mortar lines and bevelled stone edges. It stands directly on its own flat base on the floor without any added plinth or base slab. No parts are hovering, broken, or melted, and there are no glowing or unpainted elements.
blind.from_above: A narrow dark brownish-grey rectangle oriented vertically across the grid line.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.3 times as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 7.5 to 8 ft high), and roughly 0.6 to 0.7 times its height in width (around 4 to 5 ft wide).
